## Où j'en suis
Built the SRE take-home for the candidate on branch `maya/sre-take-home`: compose-based scenario (broken alert rule, flaky Go service, over-broad Terraform IAM policy), 3-hour time box, no Kubernetes. It now lives in its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` (pushed via subtree split, clean history), with a rubric of 4 areas scored 0–3 and no pass threshold. The exercise was removed from the infra branch working tree (uncommitted); no PRs were opened and nothing was emailed to anyone.

- [prochaine-étape] Thursday 4pm call with the candidate; Maya sends the exercise herself after the call and can add a collaborator invite to the private repo (source: t16).
- [prochaine-étape] Maya will drop the `maya/sre-take-home` branch later; the `hiring/` removal there is uncommitted (source: t14).
- [décision] No Kubernetes, Terraform + compose only, 3 hours max (source: t03).
- [décision] Compose builds flaky-svc from source, no prebuilt image (source: t06).
- [décision] No pass threshold: scores are input, the panel (Maya + Noa) decides (source: t10).
- [décision] Move the exercise to its own private repo, not the infra repo (source: t12).
- [décision] Delete `hiring/` from the infra branch, no PR in infra (source: t14).
- [décision] Maya sends the exercise herself; agent must not email anyone (source: t16).
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch image build with `--load` fails (`docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists`); multi-arch was sidestepped by building from source. Earlier amd64-only image gave `exec format error` on Apple Silicon.
